name: Kamaladevi Chattopadhyay
shortBio: Indian anti-colonial social theorist, feminist organizer, and cultural philosopher who linked women’s cooperative labor, artisanal aesthetics, and decentralized socialist democracy to decolonization.
centralQuestion: How can anti-colonial liberation integrate women’s economic autonomy and vernacular artisanal traditions without surrendering to industrial alienation?

keyWorks.title: The Awakening of Indian Women
keyWorks.description: Sociological and political treatise examining Indian women’s anti-imperialist organizing, labor rights, and legal equality.

keyWorks.title: Inner Recesses, Outer Spaces
keyWorks.description: Philosophical memoir reflecting on cooperative economics, folk aesthetics, and transnational solidarity.
